content.short: Covenant is a liquid credit market on Monad that turns on-chain assets into leverage and yield.
content.description: Covenant builds a credit market on Monad where on-chain assets become the basis for leverage on one side and yield on the other, with positions kept liquid rather than locked for a term. The liquidity is the differentiator: fixed-term credit is easier to price but harder to exit, and most on-chain lenders want the exit.
content.meta: A Monad credit market where positions stay liquid instead of locking for a fixed term.
